fastq_dir.title: FASTQ Folders
fastq_dir.description: Datasets or folders holding the FASTQ files (.fastq.gz). Cell Ranger finds the files of each library in the samplesheet by its sample name

transcriptome_dir.title: Transcriptome
transcriptome_dir.description: Reference genome used for alignment of RNAseq data

vdj_dir.title: V(D)J Reference
vdj_dir.description: Reference genome used for alignment of V(D)J data

feature_csv.title: Feature Reference
feature_csv.description: (optional) Reference file used for Antibody Capture or CRISPR Guide Capture

frp.title: Fixed RNA Profiling
frp.description: Optionally process Fixed RNA Profiling data with the CellRanger multi pipeline

include_introns.title: Include Introns
include_introns.description: Include reads which align to intronic regions

emptydrops_minimum_umis.title: Minimum UMIs for Cell Calling
emptydrops_minimum_umis.description: (optional) Barcodes with fewer UMIs are not considered in the second (EmptyDrops) step of cell calling. Leave blank for the CellRanger default of 500; 10X suggests starting at 100 to recover more cells. Requires CellRanger 7.1 or later

global_minimum_umis.title: Minimum UMIs per Cell
global_minimum_umis.description: (optional) Barcodes with fewer UMIs are not called as cells. Leave blank to keep every called cell (the CellRanger default). Requires CellRanger 8.0 or later

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per library: the sample name its FASTQ files start with (the part before _S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz), the grouping it belongs to, and its feature type. The libraries of a grouping, such as a sample's gene expression and V(D)J libraries, are analyzed together in one Cell Ranger run named after the grouping.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

grouping.title: Grouping
grouping.errorMessage: Groupings can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

schema.title: Probe Barcodes
schema.description: One row per sample multiplexed in each grouping, with its probe barcode (e.g. BC001), joined by a + to its antibody barcode if it has one (BC001+AB005). Leave the table empty for singleplex samples.

sample_id.title: Sample
sample_id.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

probe_barcode_ids.title: Probe Barcode IDs
probe_barcode_ids.errorMessage: Must be probe barcode IDs such as BC001, joined by a + to an antibody barcode (BC001+AB005) or by a pipe to another barcode of the same sample (BC001|BC002)
